title: Nine-Year-Old RefluXFS Linux Flaw Gives Local Users Root on Default RHEL Installs
summary: RefluXFS, a new Linux kernel flaw disclosed on July 22 and tracked as CVE-2026-64600, lets an unprivileged local user overwrite root-owned files on an XFS filesystem and gain persistent root access.

title: GitHub Cuts Public Bug Bounty Payouts, Moves Top Rewards to VIP Tier
summary: Beginning July 27, 2026, GitHub will cut public bug bounty payouts by at least half at every severity level. Critical findings will drop from $20,000-$30,000+ to a fixed $10,000, while its permanent invite-only VIP tier will pay $30,000 or more.
